server.name: io.github.bdog720/oraclarr
server.description: Read-only-by-default MCP server for diagnosing a self-hosted arr stack (Sonarr, Radarr & more).
server.title: Oraclarr

environmentVariables.description: Sonarr base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8989. Every service is ORACLARR_<NAME>_URL plus ORACLARR_<NAME>_API_KEY; the README lists the types.
environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_SONARR_URL

environmentVariables.description: Sonarr API key (Settings > General).
environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_SONARR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Radarr base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7878.
environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_RADARR_URL

environmentVariables.description: Radarr API key (Settings > General).
environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_RADARR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a config.yaml as an alternative to ORACLARR_* variables. See docs/config-file.md in the repository.
environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_CONFIG

server.name: io.github.beSaif/zenpilot

server.name: io.github.bea-technology/roxyon
server.description: Build LumenJS apps, use the Roxyon BaaS, and deploy apps and web projects to Roxyon infrastructure.

environmentVariables.description: A roxp_ personal access token (alternative to `roxyon login`). Create one with `roxyon token create`.
environmentVariables.name: ROXYON_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Override the BaaS base URL (default https://www.beaapis.com/1).
environmentVariables.name: ROXYON_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the console base URL (default https://console.roxyon.com).
environmentVariables.name: ROXYON_CONSOLE_URL
